title: 第17章 万剑归宗第18章 天下第一狂人
lines: 顺利收下两名弟，一行五人踏上了前往武当山的路。
从扬州乘坐客船一路南上。
江寒看了一眼现在的属性，已经十分豪华。
姓名：江寒
年龄：22
实力：宗师
武学：九阴真经（残）、黯然**掌、玄铁剑法、长生诀（第六、第七幅）、九玄**、井中八法、不死印法、九字真言手印、五绝神功、嫁衣神功、破·移花宫七式、神行百变、美人三招、英雄三招
改命点：680
江寒现在身上武功五花八门，但要论最顶级的，就是长生诀、井中八法、不死印法以及嫁衣神功四门了。
其中三门都是顶级内功心法，武技招式只有井中八法是顶尖。
江寒还需要一门强力武学傍身，于是把目光投向了命运商店。
在武功秘籍栏目扫了半天，江寒最终把目标放在万剑归宗上。
这是风云里的顶级剑法，也是剑法的最高境界。
一经使出万剑归宗如仆见主，如朝拜到尊神一般。
剑招一出，凌厉无匹的剑劲由体而生，身形可化着一股青烟，劲气四散弥漫。
无数利剑狂风暴雨般的飞卷。
漫天飞舞，剑势如网，凌厉无匹，蔚为奇观。
也可以操纵万剑发动攻击。
本来修炼万剑归宗需要先自废武功，不过命运商店里兜售的物品，附赠了获得秘籍就直接学成掌握的条件，省了不少事。
只是万剑归宗售价高达788改命点，江寒现在只有680，还差一百来点。
不过按照现在的节奏，等到武当山收了张无忌，身边有五名弟子，改命点获取起来也会容易不少。
半个月的时间，一行人几乎都在船上度过。
只有到一些码头停靠的时候，才有机会下船休息一下，在码头的餐馆吃一顿好的，找回一下脚踏实地的感觉。
“买到了，买到了。”
自从江小鱼和韦小宝来了后，小宝就成了最小的师弟。
加上这小子善于交际，端茶倒水买东西探查情报的事儿，也都落到了他的头上。
小宝买来了两份半月谈，其中一本给师父，另外一本则是他们师兄弟四个一起看。
江寒翻开半月谈，美滋滋地看起来。
前面的内容依旧是一些江湖中的大事件。
甚至连江寒自己也都出了镜。
讲的是他和郭靖在嘉兴铁枪庙外一战。
因为当时没有外人观战，但是战斗声势猛烈，且在空旷地带留下余波。
经过专门的勘测人员分析，这一场战斗切磋，江寒甚至占据了微弱的优势。
当这则消息发布到半月谈后，所有人都震惊了。
‘狂士’江寒上一次在半月谈出现，是破了中唐第一的天罡北斗大阵。
这次出现，和曾经的老牌地榜高手郭靖打了个平手，甚至略微占优。
新的战绩出炉后，顿时引发轩然大波。
以二十来岁的年纪，强势崛起，引人侧目。
双龙作为亲眼见证的当事人，开始为江小鱼和韦小宝追忆当时的场面。
content_en:
After successfully accepting the two younger brothers, the group of five embarked on the road to Wudang Mountain.
Take a passenger ship from Yangzhou all the way south.
Jiang Han took a look at the current attributes, which were already very luxurious.
Name: Jiang Han
Age: 22
Strength: Grandmaster
Martial arts: Nine Yin Manual (remaining), An Ran ** Palm, Black Iron Sword Technique, Immortality Secret (sixth and seventh pictures), Nine Mysterious **, Eight Methods in the Well, Immortality Seal, Nine-Character Mantra Mudra, Five Absolute Magic Techniques, Wedding Clothes Magic Technique, Seven Moves to Destroy and Move the Flower Palace, Magical Movements with Hundred Changes, Three Moves for Beauty, Three Moves for Heroes
Change life points: 680
————
Jiang Han now has a variety of martial arts skills, but the top ones are the Immortality Technique, the Eight Methods in the Well, the Immortal Seal Technique, and the Wedding Clothes Magic Technique.
Three of them are top-notch internal skills and mental techniques, and only the eight martial arts moves in the well are top-notch.
Jiang Han also needed a powerful martial arts, so he set his sights on Destiny Store.
After scanning the martial arts secrets column for a long time, Jiang Han finally set his sights on Wan Jian returning to his clan.
This is the top swordsmanship in Fengyun, and it is also the highest state of swordsmanship.
Once he has wielded ten thousand swords and returned to his clan, he is like a servant meeting his master, like worshiping a god.
As soon as the sword moves out, unparalleled sword power emerges from the body, and the body shape can turn into a puff of green smoke, and the power spreads out in all directions.
Countless swords flew like a storm.
Flying all over the sky, the sword is as powerful as a net, it is unrivaled and it is a spectacle.
Wanjian can also be manipulated to launch attacks.
Originally, to practice Ten Thousand Swords and Return to the Sect, you need to first abolish your martial arts, but the items sold in the Destiny Shop come with the condition that you can directly learn and master the secret book, which saves a lot of trouble.
It's just that the price of Wanjian Guizong is as high as 788 life-changing points, and Jiang Han only has 680 points now, which is still less than a hundred points.
However, according to the current pace, when Wudang Mountain accepts Zhang Wuji and has five disciples around him, it will be much easier to obtain life points.
The group spent almost half a month on the boat.
Only when you dock at some piers do you have the opportunity to disembark and take a rest, have a good meal at a restaurant on the pier, and get back to feeling down-to-earth.
"I bought it, I bought it."
Ever since Jiang Xiaoyu and Wei Xiaobao arrived, Xiaobao became the youngest junior disciple.
In addition, this kid is good at sociability, and the tasks of serving tea, buying things, and gathering information all fell on him.
Xiaobao bought two copies of the Half-Month Talk, one for the master and the other for the four senior brothers to read together.
Jiang Han opened the Ban Yue Tan and looked at it happily.
The previous content is still about some major events in the world.
Even Jiang Han himself appeared in the scene.
It's about the battle between him and Guo Jing outside the Iron Spear Temple in Jiaxing.
Because there were no outsiders watching the battle at the time, the battle was fierce and left aftermath in the open area.
After analysis by specialized surveyors, Jiang Han even had a slight advantage in this battle.
When this news was released to Ban Yuetan, everyone was shocked.
The last time 'Madman' Jiang Han appeared in Ban Yuetan, he broke the Tiangang Beidou Formation, which was number one in the Middle Tang Dynasty.
This time, he was tied with Guo Jing, the former veteran land leader, and even had a slight advantage.
After the new record was released, it immediately caused an uproar.
At the age of twenty-something, he has risen strongly and attracted attention.
As a person who witnessed it with his own eyes, Shuangyong began to recall the scene for Jiang Xiaoyu and Wei Xiaobao.
title_en: Chapter 17 Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Clan Chapter 18 The No. 1 Madman in the World
